title: Check Windows .cmd runner behavior inside the test-temp-root wrapper
outcome: Confirm how the shell-free temp-root wrapper handles Windows npm/npx/pnpm/yarn shims and describe the supported executable form without inventing successful Test execution.
acceptance: Bounded Windows evidence distinguishes a shim spawn failure from actual test execution and preserves the original failed outcome.
Documentation or diagnostics state any native-executable requirement that the evidence confirms.
